method: Every final page rendered by pdftoppm at scale-to 1600 and visually inspected individually.
observations: Page 1: title, draft/AI disclosure, definitions, exact conjectures and main theorem legible.
Page 2: both lemma proofs and induction complete, symbols legible, no clipping.
Page 3: cycle examples, enumeration table and scope reconciliation legible.
Page 4: formal mapping and trust limits fit together on one page.
Page 5: exact root qualifications and complete bibliography fit without clipping.
initial_revision: Initial six-page layout orphaned a trust-limit paragraph; tightened table/section spacing and re-rendered all final pages.
